verdict_reason: Correct accessor, but it is one of three new species-display helpers in this PR and lives in check-answers while the commodities feature imports it.

todos.issue: This PR adds three helpers for the text shown for a line's species: speciesLatinNameOf here (speciesLatinName ?? ''), speciesName in features/commodities/species-name.js (commonName ?? speciesLatinName) and speciesLabelFor in commodities/search/view-model/labels.js (identity). species-card-rows.js:12 also inlines entry.commonName ?? ''. The commodities feature's card/view-model.js:13 imports this one from deep inside check-answers/view-model/cards. The ?? '' adds nothing on the rows, because row() in rows/summary-row.js already renders a blank value as the not-applicable cell.
todos.fix: Must: one module owns how a commodity line's species is shown (the Latin name, and the common name where a page shows it), and every page imports it from a home that both features would look in. One way: keep features/commodities/species-name.js as the owner, export a speciesLatinNameOf-equivalent from it, delete species-latin-name.js and speciesLabelFor, and pass entry.speciesLatinName / entry.commonName straight to row() in species-card-rows.js.
